descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S07 Rows the physician deselects on the scan sheet → outcome

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given QA Oak (Cedar 1, In Today), QA Pine (Cedar 2, In Today) and QA Poplar (Cedar 3, not In Today) in All Residents, plus the fixture resident (In Today, MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'); no date of birth anywhere (D5)

When Scan a photo of Oak, Pine, Poplar and a new resident Sorrel → untick the rows of Oak, Poplar and Sorrel, keep Pine → confirm → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then Known + In Today + selected (Pine): stays on today. Known + In Today + deselected (Oak): stays on Today's Visits, or the app says before the write that Oak will leave today (Q1); never removed without a word. Known + not In Today + deselected (Poplar): stays off today and unchanged in All Residents. New + deselected (Sorrel): not created

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s07-sheet-deselected shows 'Add 1 to Today's Visits' (the three unticks registered); s07-today has QA Oak and QA Pine, not QA Poplar, and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' (U2 'adds', AC 3 'never silently dropping'); s07-all has Oak, Pine, Poplar and 'In Today ✓' and not QA Sorrel (U3, U5). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S07

Rows the physician deselects on the scan sheet → outcome

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92587 (2026-10-16; not yet checked by Quinn): failed. Local 25acd727 with a scripted read (package rst, 2026-10-16): deselected rows are not created or changed (10/10). The real read still returns nothing (B01, code unchanged), so a physician scanning a photo sees 'No residents found'. Failed on B01 until the read is fixed. The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S07: 10/10 judged pass — after unticking Oak, Poplar and Sorrel the button reads 'Add 1 to Today's Visits'; Pine (selected) stays on today; Poplar (deselected, not In Today) stays off today, unchanged in All Residents ('+ Today', Cedar 3); Sorrel (new, deselected) is not created; Oak, Pine and Poplar all remain in All Residents. Recorded (Q1, judged against UAT 'adds' it would fail): Oak, In Today and deselected, left Today's Visits, and no warning showed before the write (the sheet's subtitle 'Photo the nursing director's list — replaces today's visits' is the only hint); the fixture resident left today the same way.

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, synthetic-media. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
